   House File 639, a bill for an act relating to insurance requirements
for the granting of a hazardous liquid pipeline permit, was taken up
for consideration.

  Thomson of Floyd offered amendment H–1185 filed by Holt of
Crawford and moved its adoption.

   Amendment H–1185 was adopted.

   Holt of Crawford offered amendment H–1186 filed by the
representative and moved its adoption.

   Amendment H–1186 was adopted.

   Holt of Crawford offered amendment H–1188 filed by the
representative and moved its adoption.

   Amendment H–1188 was adopted.

  Thomson of Floyd offered amendment H–1189 filed by Holt of
Crawford and moved its adoption.

   Amendment H–1189 was adopted.

  Thomson of Floyd offered amendment H–1187 filed by Holt of
Crawford and moved its adoption.

   Amendment H–1187 was adopted.
73rd Day                      WEDNESDAY, MARCH 26, 2025                 841



   Holt of Crawford moved that the bill be read a last time now and
placed upon its passage which motion prevailed and the bill was read
a last time.

   On the question “Shall the bill pass?” (H.F. 639)
